via.name: Turnoff to Corner Peak Route

evidence: Tīmaru High River Track is signposted 50 m along the road.
For the last 900 m of the track, descend to Deer Spur Creek near Junction Hut (1.5 km).
From here you can return back the way you came, or cross the river and join the Lower Tīmaru River Track.
Tīmaru High River Track is wider than Lower Tīmaru River Track, and if used as a there-and-back track has no crossings of the Tīmaru River.

doubts: The page is titled 'Tīmaru River Tracks' and describes two tracks plus a loop combining them, so kind is network; DOC's summary time/distance (3 hr, 10.3 km one way) are the Lower Tīmaru River Track's, so it is given as the main way. The Lower track's end is the junction with the Breast Hill Track, given as the Breast Hill Track link (L1); the text does not say whether walkers then return. Junction Hut is private and is not listed as a hut. The High River Track is described both as 7.3 km one way and as usable there-and-back; it is recorded out_and_back since the loop option is its own way (W3). The loop's car park is taken as the Lower track carpark (F1), with the High River Track starting 50 m further along the road (F2).
